verdict.rationale: Google Drive documents a search guide built on the files.list method, which can return all or some of a user's files and folders, so a documented search API exists. The pack never shows that this API queries full-text file content or goes beyond name matching. The only content-search evidence is a community note that OCR makes scanned documents searchable, and that describes user-facing search, not the API. Missing for 10: documented full-text/content query support in the API (e.g. query operators over file contents), documented filename query semantics beyond prefix matching, and independent hands-on corroboration of API content search.
